text: {"lessons":["Selling winners quickly may feel reassuring, but I should weigh each stock’s prospects and my target allocation before reducing a position.","I sold Stock C at a large loss after holding through its decline; next time I should review my reasons and risks earlier rather than let reluctance to realize a loss drive the decision.","My account value fluctuated while I traded infrequently, so I should check my portfolio periodically and make measured decisions aligned with my goals, not short-term price moves."]}
